datasheet_identity.title: ZVN3320F SOT23 N-Channel Enhancement Mode Vertical MOSFET

extraction_notes: The supplied manufacturer PDF is the ZVN3320F datasheet, document DS33359 Rev. 4 - 2, dated May 2024; all six pages were examined. The ordered suffix is ZVN3320FTA.
The device is identified as an N-channel enhancement-mode vertical MOSFET. Electrical-characteristics values are specified at TA = +25 degC unless otherwise noted.
Threshold voltage is preserved as separate minimum and maximum values at VDS = VGS and ID = 1 mA. The table publishes no typical threshold value.
The RDS(on) table publishes 17 ohm typical and 25 ohm maximum at VGS = 10 V and ID = 100 mA. Both values are retained as separate schema points.
The capacitance table publishes maximum values only: Ciss = 45 pF, Coss = 18 pF, and Crss = 5 pF at VDS = 25 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz. Values are converted to SI units.
The table also publishes IDSS maximum 10 uA at VDS = 200 V, VGS = 0 V and 50 uA at VDS = 160 V, VGS = 0 V, TA = +125 degC; these fields are not representable in the strict schema.
Additional table fields include gfs minimum 75 mS at VDS = 25 V and ID = 100 mA, switching times, and RthetaJA maximum 380 degC/W. These fields are not representable in the strict schema.
Curve points are conservative manual digitizations of visible plotted grid locations from the cited manufacturer figures. No values were interpolated or extrapolated beyond the displayed traces.
Figure 10 prints f = 1 MHz and the related capacitance table specifies VGS = 0 V at the tabulated bias. Its logarithmic capacitance axis and all three traces are retained with SI-unit points.
